title: Cancelled flights
statementMd:
How many flights were cancelled? Show the count.

Expected columns: `cancelled`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled FROM flights WHERE status = 'cancelled';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
